spaces.label: Code (Assembled)
spaces.description: The marketplace-assembly TEST SPACE. All THREE of its session-surface sections are INDEPENDENT implementations assembled from the published PARTS: independent-composer (Composer, ComposerTips, the goal/usage surfaces, the capability adapters), independent-thread (Thread, SectionSessionScope, PresenceSurface, OpeningThreadSkeleton) and independent-rail (SessionRail, the rail chrome pieces, and the three assembly hooks that carry the presence/reorder/primary-action judgement). Its switcher, workspace host, dock column and environment card are packs re-exporting the SHIPPED implementations from @fraym/ui (a granted pack external), byte-identical to the built-in Code space by construction. Its top-bar chrome is DELIBERATELY not: `workspace.actions` is `["environment"]`, so this space draws only the environment affordance (owner-directed 2026-08-30). The dock and the other controls are absent by choice, not by defect — and the dock SURFACE is still reachable by intent, because a control and a surface are separate questions (doc 69 §7.1). This space is the owner-directed experiment that pressure-tests the parts decomposition. The acceptance gate is a live structural and behavioral comparison against the built-in Code space on the same session, SCOPED TO THE SESSION SURFACE (rail, thread, composer, workspace host): DOM multiset equality, byte-identical geometry, and a behavior matrix — with fiber provenance proving the pack renders rather than a silent fallback to the built-in.

preview.tagline: The full Code experience, assembled entirely from marketplace parts — pixel-identical to the built-in.
